about: Reference side of the Inkling 2 vision gate v2.2: per-op added error of the transformers bf16 tower (gate a); the minimum over 19 distinct equally valid bf16 realizations of its distance to float32, each realization held out against the other 18 (missed checks, largest shortfall per check; diagnostic b); and the range of oracle prompt e top-1 over the same 19 reference embedding realizations through our text model (gate c).
